original_card.question: Can a new local cost interface change the deficit-to-recursive-cost ratio beyond current packing?
methods: Propose a changed helper inventory and derive an optimistic exact moment.
Design a small completed instance and independently verify its endpoint and rank bill.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A new physically realizable contract outside the frozen catalogue whose per-call profile, screened with ceiling.ceiling(), beats the selected word's packing ceiling; a lower cap does not establish identical circuitry or order attainable optima, and is insufficient to pass the stronger-budget target under this model. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Packing of the selected word is capped at +0.87% (ceiling model); only a lower local excess spend or a changed coverage law raises the cap.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one changed boundary or helper type with explicit counts.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Mixing only providers already inside the pinned catalogue.
Only changing helper terminal subspaces and monotone frames within the fixed scalar word, entrances and cleanup contract already covered by #1995/#2013.

Continuing a partial cost improvement while leaving the same unpriced consumer, restoration or central-readout obligation unresolved; refresh the family expansion decision first. Local product-retiming evidence has a narrow scope and is not a ban on changed graphs or contracts.

actual_scope: On PR2979's words (Marius-Paul Dumitrean: PR2942 plus joint codimension-2 end-frame lowering of 22 restored helpers to five shared rank-7 subspaces, five further rank-8 paired extractions at normals 42 and 7 with 91 private buffers, and Jeremy Kothe's fourteen PR2957 rewrites), PR3015's declared literal edit stage (Jeremy Kothe), and PR3042's six restore carrier/pivot skips (R1_E42 on restore[162:188], 26 -> 33 gates skipping {22, 40, 54, 63}; R2_E7 on restore[190:203], 13 -> 15 gates skipping {5, 73}): two coupled B+restore dying-helper carrier folds (B_586_438 and B_588_440, 6 hunks / 6 -> 5 gates each) that fold dying helpers 438 and 440 into source registers 75 and 84 (so B loses 2 gates and cleanup gains 2 gates at FULL: 75 += 1/2*438 and 84 -= 440, with restore unchanged except for the frames at [85] and [88]) and lower helper_final[586] to V_{30,76,82} and helper_final[588] to V_{30,97,127} (dim 8 -> 7, width 7 -> 6, shifting the width inventory from {4:26, 5:2, 6:16, 7:52, 8:99, 9:213} to {4:26, 5:2, 6:18, 7:50, 8:99, 9:213}), paired with a repacked literal T74 allocation (T74_optimal_idle39) and complete fresh-native admission and modern outer release.
scope_change_reason: The card asks whether a changed helper inventory or local cost interface beats current packing, and Priority Revision 6 (docs/research/current-priorities.md) requires naming the changed hypothesis before reopening domains bounded by fixed-endpoint optimality results (PR #3065 joint frame optimum and PR #3114 restore-only optimum on PR #3042's words). Coupling a B-phase dying-helper carrier fold on (586, 438) and (588, 440) with Stage-1 helper_final lowering changes the helper endpoint width inventory ({6:16, 7:52} -> {6:18, 7:50}), overcoming the -3,345 Stage-1-only and -973 Stage-2-only negative controls for a +665 per-helper (+1,330 joint) surrogate margin against the rounded guide BE = 2,091,300.
bottleneck_link: Combined with R1_E42 (-8 H1 + 4 H2 = -19,984) and R2_E7 (-4 H1 + 2 H2 = -9,992), the coupled carrier folds B_586_438 (+6 H2 - 2 H3 - 3 H4 + 1 H5 = -2,091,965 vs rounded guide BE = -2,091,300 -> +665 surrogate margin) and B_588_440 (+6 H2 - 2 H3 - 3 H4 + 1 H5 = -2,091,965 vs rounded guide BE = -2,091,300 -> +665 surrogate margin) move the per-call local profile from PR2979's {1:2445, 2:706, 3:232, 4:108, 5:18, 8:8} (and PR3042's {1:2433, 2:712, 3:232, 4:108, 5:18, 8:8}) to {1:2433, 2:724, 3:228, 4:102, 5:20, 8:8} and shift the width inventory to {4:26, 5:2, 6:18, 7:50, 8:99, 9:213} at 91 private buffers. The fixed-capacity relaxation cap rises to [0.0017297774946785970118869, 0.0017297774946785970118870] (+3.95446143e-8 over PR3054's T740 cap) and the certified literal T74 release reaches κ = 0.001729776089405120334238 - 10^-46 - 10^-70 (+3.99230172e-8 above PR3042's T74 root and +3.81393408e-8 above PR3054/PR3115's T740 root).
stop_rule: Freeze the four declared edits (R1_E42, R2_E7, B_586_438, B_588_440) after exact local checks, 21-control per-word tamper review, and 91-helper causal lower-bound exhaustion scan; publish a higher conditional kappa only if both native providers, literal T74 owner geometry, physical stock, prefix and complete outer admission pass strictly above PR2979, PR3042, and PR3054.
